sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Full Stack Lead Developer S&P Global CapitalIQ Aug 2022 – Jun 2026 ▸ Engineered a high-performance financial web platform with ReactJS, Node JS and PostgreSQL on AWS (EKS, Lambda, S3, Redis, CloudWatch). integrated LLM APIs for smart search. ▸ Led a cross-functional team of 4 engineers, gathering and translating business requirements into technical specifications, guiding sprint planning and code reviews, and managing end-to-end release cycles from deployment planning to production rollout while serving as the primary point of contact for stakeholder communication and progress updates.
Full Stack Architect Skata Software Pvt. Ltd. Aug 2021 – Jul 2022 ▸ Sole architect for a multi-tenant SaaS e-commerce platform built from scratch: system topology, DB schemas, and REST API contracts. ▸ Built secure Node.js/PostgreSQL backend with JWT auth and rate-limiting for high-concurrency, multi-vendor onboarding and order routing.
Senior Software Engineer NCR Corporation Pvt. Ltd. Apr 2018 – Aug 2021 ▸ Migrated the ATM omnichannel marketing campaign engine from AE 2.0 to AE 3.0 three months ahead of schedule. built the AngularJS campaign-builder UI and Node.js scheduling/segmentation APIs.
Junior Software Engineer OSI Digital Pvt. Ltd. Oct 2014 – Apr 2018 ▸ Developed UI components for the Macy's Credit Gateway (Backbone.js) with full Jasmine/Karma test coverage, supporting nationwide retail e-commerce.
